title: Find the full names and hometown cities of members who are enrolled in majo
question: Find the full names and hometown cities of members who are enrolled in majors from the College of Humanities and Social Sciences and who attended events with more than 20 attendees that were not fundraisers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", T5."XCL_045"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1."XCL_042" = T2."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T5 ON T1."XCL_041" = T5."XCL_043"
INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T1."XCL_034" = T3."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_010"
WHERE T2."XCL_033" = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
  AND T4."XCL_013" != 'Fundraiser'
  AND T4."XCL_010" IN (
    SELECT T2."XCL_001" FROM attendance AS T2 GROUP BY T2."XCL_001" HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_002") > 20
  )
